description: Reduced anonymized CFB right-of-way cached linework around the remaining Shapely/Rust perimeter-band parity gap.
reason: Reduced crop around the largest CFB rw Shapely-only component. Unfiltered Shapely snap/unary_union/polygonize returns 116 polygons and 785,802.572787 area; Rust 0.36.x currently returns 114 polygons and about 739,588.82 area. This preserves the pre-snap/noding parity gap with 327 cached lines instead of the full 2,966-line rw fixture.
